source: real capture (Wireshark sample set), radiotap + 802.11, 2.4 GHz channel 5
description: 4,274-frame real WPA capture containing exactly two EAPOL-Key frames (M1 and M2) and nothing after: an incomplete 4-way handshake inside a large, otherwise healthy capture.

mustReport.detail: EAPOL 4-way handshake stops after M2: exactly 2 EAPOL-Key frames in 4,274 frames, no M3/M4 anywhere in the remaining 4,257 frames

certaintyGovernance.cause: at most 'likely' - missing M3/M4 can be a PSK mismatch, a supplicant abort, or monitor-mode capture loss; the engine must not assert 'wrong password'
certaintyGovernance.captureLoss: must be offered as an alternative explanation because monitor-mode capture is inherently lossy

notes: Scale + sparsity fixture: two significant frames buried in 4,274. A rule engine that only scans the first N frames still passes; one that mis-scopes EAPOL to a per-BSS counter and reports 'complete' fails. Retry rate 0.585% must stay below the item 15 alert threshold.
